segments.name: capital equipment
segments.description: Develops and sells wafer cleaning, plating and packaging equipment to semiconductor manufacturers.
segments.evidence: As the Company is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of capital equipment to global semiconductor manufacturers, and each of the operating segments share similar economic and other qualitative characteristics, the results of the Company's operating segments are aggregated into one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor manufacturers, mostly in Asia, buy its process equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, a substantial majority of our sales of semiconductor capital equipment have been to customers located in Asia, and we anticipate that a substantial majority of our revenue from these products will continue to come from customers located in this region for the foreseeable future.
